acceptance.given: Disposable packages declare subprocess capabilities, with all unrelated declarations held valid and timeout variants independently defined in frozen test code.

oracle.expected: An explicit finite timeout satisfies the subprocess-timeout declaration check. An omitted or non-finite timeout causes rejection with structured diagnostics identifying the timeout defect and affected declaration path. Validation does not execute the declared subprocess.
forbidden: A subprocess capability without a timeout passes validation.
A subprocess capability with a non-finite timeout passes validation.
A finite timeout is rejected as missing or non-finite.
The validator executes the declared subprocess to determine timeout validity.
A missing production import, collection error, environment failure or harness timeout is reported as causal RED.
oracle.observable: Parameter-specific assertions in scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_capabilities.py::test_a20 inspect the declaration timeout and the structured status, timeout-related rule ID, code and diagnostic path returned by the real scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package entry. A subprocess-execution sentinel detects any attempt to run the inspected command.

acceptance.then: Each subprocess capability must explicitly declare a finite timeout; missing and non-finite timeout declarations fail static validation.
acceptance.when: The frozen A20 timeout parameter cases call the real validator during controlled behavior probing, regression and terminal verification.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Author scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_capabilities.py::test_a20 with independently marked finite, missing and non-finite timeout parameters. Directly call scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package and raise an observable AssertionError when a finite timeout fails its declaration check or a missing/non-finite timeout is accepted. Use the targeted argv command with a caller-enforced 300-second limit. Import, fixture, collection and environment failures are not this observation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback only the affected Package A timeout-validation changes while preserving unrelated public CLI/API and schema behavior. No live data migration, Runner replacement or runtime timeout engine is authorized. Preserve historical failure evidence and invalidate affected proofs after shared policy/schema/validator changes.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every frozen A20 timeout parameter executes through the real validator with its own assertion binding and independently frozen expectations; finite declarations satisfy the timeout rule and missing/non-finite declarations are rejected. Tests detect unconditional-pass substitution and attempted subprocess execution.
